notes:
I found two free drop-in options in Halton Hills. Each comes from the operator's own page or the Region's page.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "EarlyON Child and Family Centres, Links2Care (Acton and Georgetown)",
      "age_fit": "children from birth to their 6th birthday, with a parent or caregiver",
      "source_name": "Links2Care",
      "price": "FREE"
    },
    {
      "name": "Kids & Me drop-in, Halton Hills Public Library – Acton Branch",
      "age_fit": "families with babies or children up to 6 years of age",
      "when": "Thursdays 10:30 a.m. to 12 p.m. It follows the school calendar, starting the second week of September, and is closed for the December/January holidays, spring and summer breaks, and statutory holidays.",
      "source_name": "Halton Region"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Links2Care EarlyON:** 
Programs are free for children from birth to their 6th birthday and their parents or caregivers, and are offered in Halton Hills.
 
Some programs are drop-in and some are registered.
 Their page has a current schedule, but I couldn't pull specific days and times from it, so I've left `when` out. Its Halton Hills locations include 
Acton (85 Wallace St), Acton Community Hub (69 Acton Blvd) and Georgetown (8 James St)
.
- **Kids & Me:** The Region lists this at 
the Halton Hills Public Library Acton Branch, Thursdays from 10:30 a.m. to 12 p.m.
 
The library describes it as a free weekly 1.5-hour parenting and early learning drop-in program.
 The Region's page doesn't state a price, so I've left `price` out of the pick.
